description: Illustrative insurance KYC engagement with a healthcare customer switch. Local review-logic tests use synthetic extracted fields; no model, patient records or customer system accessed.

scenes.label: Workshop
scenes.prompt: @fde Insurer workshop: Ops wants faster ID checks. Compliance must approve every case.
scenes.answer: Agreed: AI prepares the document review; Compliance makes the decision. First, measure the time reviewers spend.

scenes.label: Scope
scenes.prompt: Their CTO approved the internal model. Start with synthetic IDs and the existing review screen.
scenes.answer: First build: extract ID fields, flag missing or conflicting details, and prepare a review. No automatic customer approval.

scenes.label: Build
scenes.prompt: Build the review step. Keep it inside their current system.
scenes.answer: Added kyc-review.js: turns extracted fields into a reviewer summary. Missing or conflicting details get flagged. Tests are next.

scenes.label: Switch customer
scenes.prompt: @fde Save this. Healthcare client call now: IT has not approved access to patient records.
scenes.answer: KYC saved: review step built; tests next. Healthcare: use synthetic intake forms. Ask IT who owns access approval and when.

scenes.label: Resume and test
scenes.prompt: @fde Back to insurance. Pick up the tests.
scenes.answer: Resumed from the saved step. 6/6 local checks pass: complete, missing, unreadable and conflicting fields. Every case still needs a reviewer.

scenes.label: Rollout decision
scenes.answer: Not yet. Test their model and review screen with approved samples. Compliance signs off before a pilot with one team.

scenes.label: Handover preparation
scenes.prompt: Prepare the handover for Ops and IT.
scenes.answer: Draft ready: reviewer steps, support owner and manual fallback. Next: customer testing, then compare review time with the baseline.
